subject: Sprint to the Quarter: objective cascade, alignment points, and exec endorsement
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloud-marketplace.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint to the Quarter: objective cascade, alignment points, and exec endorsement

Team — kicking off the Q2 objective cascade. Attached is a short playbook and the initial metrics workbook (Q2_OKR_metrics_master.xlsx). Goal is to lock owners and top-level targets by EOD Friday so we can present a consolidated packet for exec sign-off next week.

Quick asks:
- Please review the playbook sections you own (product, infra, post-sales) and add solid owner names in column B of the workbook.
- Flag any target that needs a dependency (cross-org) or a resource ask.
- If you see a metric that cannot be reliably measured this quarter, mark it "defer" with a brief reason.

Proposed cadence:
- Today/Thu: internal review and comments in doc
- Fri: leadership alignment and final edits
- Mon (exec sync): formal sign-off (I can put on the calendar for 10:00 PT)

Attachments: Q2_objectives_playbook_v1.pdf (one-pager), Q2_OKR_metrics_master.xlsx

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, GTM Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Sprint to the Quarter: objective cascade, alignment points, and exec endorsement

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 09:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — kicking off the Q2 objective cascade. Attached is a short playbook and the initial metrics workbook...

Thanks Vanessa — read this through. A few quick notes inline and attached: exec_review_notes.pptx has a one-slide redline on the top-level KPIs.

Major asks from Product:
- Tighten the adoption metric: change "active integrations" to "integrations with >=1k requests/day" (this avoids partial / vanity counts).
- Remove the vague "improve quality" metric; replace with a measurable eval set (I added a sheet in the workbook).

I'll annotate the playbook PDF with ownership calls. If we want an executive-ready page, I can produce a TL;DR slide with 3 bullets per objective.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec_review_notes.pptx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint to the Quarter: objective cascade, alignment points, and exec endorsement

Thanks — couple infrastructure constraints to call out before we lock:
- Capacity: planned Dedicated capacity increase is delayed by two weeks; if Product expects a sustained 30% gen token throughput increase, we need a mitigation (either staggered rollout or temporary burst pool).
- Cost target: Finance asked we keep per-token cost delta under 12% vs Q1 for hosted workloads. I outlined two levers in the workbook (quantization profile + smarter prefix caching).

Action items for infra owners:
- Mark any objective that depends on increased capacity with an "INFRA_DEP" tag in the workbook.
- Priyom, can you confirm whether burst capacity can be provisioned for the first two weeks of the quarter?

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sprint to the Quarter: objective cascade, alignment points, and exec endorsement

Morning — adding customer-facing readiness items we need for QBR and launch readiness:
- Enable checklists for the top 5 strategic customers (BrightSpace pilot). I've added a sheet called "QBR_Readiness" in the workbook with owner suggestions.
- Training: short enablement play (45 min) for CS/SE before we turn on the new workflow; suggest week 2.
- Escalations: propose a retention policy note in the playbook (legal asked for clarity).

Can we include a short table in the TL;DR slide (Laura) showing customer impact and mitigation plan? That helps with exec sign-off.

Monica Patel
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
